aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable VP OK/G2/G3 test evidence but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are not yet reliable.
issues: Changed factor incorrectly mixes baseline, test labels, and row number value 4.
Baseline/test relationship is ambiguous; OK may be comparator rather than unstated baseline.
Content says VP OK/G2/NG while title and outcomes use OK/G2/G3.
Measurement outcome from Report!37 appears to be a header/stat artifact, not a separate measured result.
Some cited result rows are not shown in context, limiting verification of parsed values.
requiredUserQuestions: Should VP OK be treated as the baseline/comparator for VP G2 and VP G3?
Is the intended third material grade G3 or NG?
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to VP material condition OK vs G2 vs G3/NG based on source rows.
Remove row-number artifact 4 from changedCondition and subgroup keys.
Keep laser cutting and function checking as outcomes under the same VP material validation only if rows align by type.
Drop or rebuild the Report!37 measurement outcome using actual data rows, not header-derived stats.
Ensure all result-row citations include the rows containing each condition and numeric result.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient until grouping and parsed-result evidence are corrected.
